_meta.description: What authored text the v2 renderer needs. The words themselves live in the shared callout registry under module 'tabs' and are edited in the Callout Editor; this file is the renderer's contract with them. Validated at build time by report_text.R — a key here with no entry in the registry, or a placeholder in the registry that is not declared here, refuses the build.
_meta.format: key -> { page, context, tokens }. page groups the entry in the Callout Editor and should match a v2 tab. context says where on that tab it renders, so an author knows what they are changing. tokens lists the {placeholders} the renderer supplies for that key; any other {lower_snake_case} in the authored text is a typo and refuses the build.
_meta.authoring:
Text is the CONTENT of its block — the renderer supplies the surrounding

/

and the data-txt-key tag. Inline markup is limited to strong em b i br p ul ol li h3 h4 span code, balanced, with no attributes. Blank text renders nothing at all, which is how an author switches a block off without touching code.

report.construction.produced.context: About card, Report construction — the attribution sentence. Always rendered, and prepended to a study's own _REPORT_CONSTRUCTION note unless that note names the producer itself.

report.construction.computed.context: About card, Report construction — completes the attribution paragraph. Stock note only; a study's own _REPORT_CONSTRUCTION replaces it.

report.construction.self_contained.context: About card, Report construction — what the file is and what recalculates as the reader clicks. Stock note only.

report.construction.prior_waves_publishe.context: About card, Report construction — rendered ONLY when the report carries earlier waves and none of them holds respondent-level scores, i.e. when the figures really are carried forward rather than recalculated. Stock note only.

report.construction.ai_and_review.context: About card, Report construction — where AI does and does not act, and who is accountable. Stock note only; a study's own _REPORT_CONSTRUCTION replaces this too, and then owns the disclosure.
